lines.fw1: Diffusion models learn by watching pictures being destroyed. Step by step, noise is added, until only static is left.
lines.fw2: At every step, the model is shown the noisy image, and asked to predict the noise that was added.
lines.bw1: To generate, we run it in reverse. Start from pure random noise.
lines.bw2: The model removes a little noise at each step, and a picture slowly emerges.
lines.pr1: A text prompt steers the denoising. The words are turned into embeddings, which guide every step.
lines.pr2: Different noise gives a different picture, even for the same prompt.
lines.outro: Add noise to learn. Remove noise to create. Guided by your words, static turns into an image.
